ABOUT GRANT CARDONE

From Broke at 25 to Building Billions.

The Largest Small Business Company in America.
Grant Cardone manages over $5B in real estate with the mission of democratizing success in business, real estate, and wealth. From starting broke at 25 to building a global business empire, Grant Cardone has spent over 40 years creating companies, acquiring real estate assets, and developing proven systems that help entrepreneurs and business owners grow. Through his companies, investments, and educational platforms, Grant Cardone has built one of the world’s most recognized companies helping entrepreneurs build businesses and create wealth.

Step Into the Room Where Capital Is Raised. A private, one-day workshop with Grant Cardone focused on

Event Details

Step Into the Room Where Capital Is Raised.

A private, one-day workshop with Grant Cardone focused on the strategies, systems, and tools used to raise capital and scale real estate investments.

What You’ll Learn

  • How to structure deals investors want to fund
  • Understand the legal and compliance frameworks used by Grant’s team
  • How to present and pitch investment opportunities
  • Strategies to attract accredited and non-accredited investors
  • How to use pitch decks, agreements, and investor materials

What You’ll Get

  • Full-day, in-person training with Grant Cardone
  • Capital Raising Blueprint Workbook
  • Templates for pitch decks, PPMs, and subscription agreements
  • Scripts, slides, and marketing materials
  • Networking with active investors and dealmakers
  • Private deal review for the first 50 participants

Limited to 50 Participants

This is a closed-door experience designed for investors who have opportunities in front of them but need a stronger framework for raising capital and funding larger deals.

Investment: $10,000. Includes direct access to Grant, the workshop training, materials, and networking with investors and dealmakers in the room.
